expected_structural_delta: Adds one helper include and one test file; no new owners, services, or persistence.
minimum_design: One shared PHP helper in dynamix.my.servers/include (OsVersionBranch) that keeps the Unraid 7 plugin-category path, reads the branch key from the OSTree updater config with strict validation and a stable default, and is called from state.php and UnraidCheck.php; a php-cli test wired into the existing plugin test script.
outcome: On Unraid OS 8 (OSTree hosts without an unRAIDServer.plg), ServerState::osVersionBranch and the unraidcheck branch/current_version query parameters reflect the installed release branch recorded by Core in /boot/config/os-update.json instead of always falling back to stable.

reuse_decisions.name: plugin category lookup via PluginHelpers/plugin CLI
reuse_decisions.rationale: Unraid 7 keeps deriving the branch from the installed OS plugin CATEGORY

reuse_decisions.name: plugin/tests php-cli harness (test-extractor.php pattern)
reuse_decisions.rationale: No phpunit config exists; the repo CI runs plugin tests through pnpm test

reuse_decisions.name: /etc/unraid-version parse_ini_file
reuse_decisions.rationale: Already used for the patcher version comparison; supplies current_version on OS 8
